entry.title: New: Bill 49 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR OF THE COUNTY OF MAUI TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR A LOAN FROM THE STATE OF HAWAII'S DRINKING WATER STATE REVOLVING FUND FOR LEAD AND COPPER RULE REVISION COMPLIANCE, FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET ORDINANCE" The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Mayor to enter into an intergovernmental agreement with the State of Hawaii for a loan from the Drinking Water Revolving Fund in the amount of $1,502,403 for Lead and Copper Rule Revision Compliance.
